fan_ballot_close.note: Xinhua (Dec 17, 2004) on the NBA balloting update: 'The balloting continues through January 23'

starters_announced.note: the same update: results issued 'leading up to an unveiling on February 3' (Thursday)

coach_record_through.note: best winning percentage in each conference 'through the games of February 6, 2005' names the game's coaches

reserves_announced.note: AP (ESPN, Feb 8, 2005): 'the selections Tuesday, when the NBA announced the reserves for the Feb. 20 game'

rookie_challenge_announced.note: InsideHoops files the NBA's roster release ('lead a list of 18 players selected to play in the 2005 got milk? NBA Rookie Challenge') under the heading '2005 NBA ROOKIE CHALLENGE | JAN. 27, 2005'; the NBA's own release was not loaded

replacements_named.note: the commissioner names injury replacements before the weekend; the simulation names them on the Friday the weekend opens, from closed results through the day before

electorates.reserves: the conference's head coaches, never their own players
electorates.rookie_challenge: the NBA's assistant coaches, one ballot per club staff

previous_game_coaches.note: the Riley Rule: no coach coaches two All-Star Games in a row; these are the REAL 2004 game's coaches. The simulated 2004 game (Stats_and_Awards/League/2003-04/all_star.json) was coached by Lawrence Frank (East) and Flip Saunders (West); runtime/all_star.py reads only this value, so the simulated record is not consulted

fan_ballot_open.note: Xinhua: 'the balloting program, which began on November 18'; NBA.com release dated 041118 ('Fat Albert Highlights 2005 NBA All-Star Balloting', no longer served). Ballots in all 30 arenas, NBA.com in 19 languages, Verizon Wireless, Foot Locker and Champs Sports (search summary of the release).

starters_announced.note: Scheduled 'unveiling on February 3' in the balloting update; reports of the starters dated Feb 4, 2005 (Beijing time) agree.

starter_shape_per_conference.note: 'Two guards, two forwards and one center who received the highest vote were named the All-Star starters.'

value.voters: the 30 NBA head coaches, each voting within own conference

reserves.note: AP: 'The league's 30 coaches chose the reserves' ... 'Coaches were required to select two guards, two forwards, one center and two other players regardless of position.' Wikipedia: 'The coaches were not permitted to vote for their own players.' First season with 30 clubs (Charlotte).

injury_replacement.note: AP: for an injured selection 'NBA commissioner David Stern will select his replacement'. That the coach chooses a replacement STARTER remains unverified for this season, as in 2003-04.

value.rule: head coach of the team with the best winning percentage in each conference through games of 2005-02-06 (Sunday two weeks before the game)
value.repeat_restriction: 'Riley Rule': a coach may not coach consecutive All-Star Games; the next-best record coaches instead

coaches_rule.note: Tie-break procedure between equal records unverified.

value.name: got milk? Rookie Challenge
value.format: Rookies vs Sophomores (6th year of this format)
value.selected_by: the NBA's assistant coaches, each club's staff submitting one ballot
value.team_coaches: lead assistants from the 2005 All-Star Game coaching staffs

rookie_challenge.note: Release: '18 players selected ... The participants in the got milk? NBA Rookie Challenge were selected by the NBA's assistant coaches with each team submitting one ballot.' A change from 2004's broadcaster panel. Game rules for 2005 not loaded (2004 and 2006: two 20-minute halves).

rookie_challenge_rosters_announced.note: Date from the InsideHoops heading over the NBA release; the NBA's own dated release was not loaded.

saturday_contests.note: Participant selection (league invitation) and announcement dates not researched; event order unverified.
